_about: Entra Policy Suite - every right of every identity, ONE list (framework RIGHTS-1.6 / NAMING-PROGRAMME-1, owner 2026-11-09: "each solution must know exactly what is needed for each identity"). The install grants from it ADD-ONLY (missing -> added, read back; a right outside it is reported, never removed - owner 2026-11-09 "i have not approved any removal of graph rights ... then we can talk about clean-up later"); the setup steps verify against it; the security pack prints it; tests/Test-EpsRights.ps1 fails when code grants a right not listed here. SQL object grants per role are in sql/eps-grants.json (tested both ways by Test-EpsSqlGrants) - this file names the role. Scopes: <rg> = the install's resource group; <acr>, <kv>, <st>, <sql> = the install's registry, key vault, storage account, SQL server. 'when': always | a feature switch (granted only while it is on, removed when off).
